description: CODAS Energy Router: Energy Storage is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This dataset is part of a DC-coupled microgrid simulation environment using ORNL's Control and Optimization using Distributed Agent-based System (CODAS) in the control hardware-in-the-loop (CHIL) real-time testbed. The utilization of energy resources such as photovoltaics (PV), energy storage, and electric vehicle batteries is becoming increasingly possible for residential homeowners. However, challenges remain on the integration. Coverage: the United States. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Electricity, Residential. Its keywords are photovoltaics, energy storage, residential systems, energy router (ER), DC microgrid, distributed energy resource. The portal shows 2025-10-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
